sections.t: No activity logged, so the 3.3 km long run was missed. The rest of week 1 was complete: all four lifting sessions and both easy runs.
Rest day, the start of week 2. A relaxed walk is fine as recovery, but keep it easy and skip any extra training.

Keep eating at about 1,750 kcal and 130 g protein even though it is a rest day, since recovery is when muscle gets built. Start with a Skyr berry bowl and finish with Hake with lentils to spread protein across the day.

With the long run missed, keep this Sunday at about 3.3 km instead of the planned 3.6 km, since your longest run in the past 30 days is about 3.0 km. Also keep Wednesday's easy run at 8:30-9:00/km; last week's was 7:53/km, which is faster than easy.
